findings.statement: Official scan run 45631813130: 50 candidates, 45 qualified, 25 outlier rows (23 unique videos), 0 errors, 95 API calls / 590 quota units.
All returned candidates have hidden subscriber counts; max_subs gate unverified. Ratios are relative signals only.
Story Goat short aAuJx9wr72k: 18,336,931 views, 20 s, median 27,678 => 662.51x. Hook is a fossilized mixed-species burrow pair from the Early Triassic.

Primary paper (Fernandez et al. 2013, PLOS ONE 8(6):e64978) confirms synchrotron scanning of a lithified Karoo burrow cast: injured Broomistega sheltered with an aestivating Thrinaxodon; healed rib fractures and no tooth marks support shelter, not predation. Both were later trapped by flood.
Extinct Life channel snapshot: 87 subscribers, 14 videos, 27,493 lifetime views, joined 2024-11-26. Greenland 7:19 film euAk1gHHql4 had 1 view; related short re0nOdM4yZk had 251 views and 0 likes.
The 528-view Greenland short found in search belongs to Ghost Genomes, not Extinct Life; keep competing-channel samples separate.
Other scan hits such as Jewish DNA, hazel-eye ancestry and South Indian ancestry outrank the fossil story on raw ratio but are off-brand and carry unverified human-genetics claims; reject.

Ancient-DNA-from-bone (t750oAZGzmM, 8.32M views / 375.65x) and T-Rex standing-still physics (tI_UFQ6eOfU, 5.88M / 75.78x) are valid secondary angles but overlap existing channel territory or need separate claim ledgers.

V6.2 feasibility: a 9:16 cutaway can show the burrow cast, synchrotron sweep, two skeleton silhouettes, healed ribs and flood infill using parametric lofting and X-ray pass; no gore and no living-animal footage needed.
No thumbnail contact sheet or visual audit was performed; i.ytimg.com remains unreachable from this sandbox.
